changes: Your Omi keeps recording after a network change or a reconnect during sync, and recordings waiting to sync upload on their own instead of waiting for a restart
Tapping the "Omi isn't sending audio" banner now reconnects in place instead of leaving the page
A full phone disk pausing recordings, or an upload stalled for hours, now shows up under Needs attention in the Activity bell
Pausing a recording in Transcribe Later mode no longer leaves the screen loading or the timer frozen
Mind Map shows your saved memories while connections are still loading, and can load more results
Summaries keep their headings, nested lists and spacing
Smaller fixes for tasks, device diagnostics and Connect an Agent
